rows.content: Episode summary: The agent processed a set of belief-memory operations: it stated an initial belief, corrected it, confirmed it, inferred an additional belief from available information, and then confirmed the inferred belief. No external tools were used beyond the internal memory/belief system, and the outcome was an updated and validated set of beliefs stored in memory.

The agent used its memory system to record and update internal state: it stated several beliefs, created a goal and marked it completed, then corrected a belief. It subsequently created additional goals, confirmed and inferred beliefs, superseded one goal with another, and later abandoned a newly created goal. The episode ends with the agent having updated/validated its beliefs and leaving at least one new goal created but not yet completed.

Episode summary: The agent recorded a belief in memory (memory.belief.stated) and then confirmed it twice (memory.belief.confirmed x2). No other tools or external actions were used, and the outcome was that the belief ended in a confirmed state in memory.

The agent performed a series of internal memory-management actions: it stated and confirmed several beliefs, created a goal and marked it completed, corrected a belief, then created additional goals—one of which was superseded and another abandoned. It also inferred and confirmed a new belief before ending by creating a final goal. No external tools were used beyond the agent’s memory system, and the outcome was an updated set of beliefs plus a new active goal to pursue.
